label_policy.label_definition: The current public snapshot supports resolution tracing from warning letter to closeout letter. It does not support SEC-style response-adequacy review because public company response letters are almost absent.

feedback_policy.scalar: closeout existence or delay bucket, after adding negative/non-closeout controls
feedback_policy.category: product, subject, issuing office, and violation family
feedback_policy.full_text: closeout language describing FDA's evaluation of corrective actions

risks: Public company response letters are almost absent, so request-response-evidence review is not directly observable.
The current linked candidate set is positive-only; classification needs negative or not-yet-closeout controls.

minimal_experiment.next_action: Use as an adaptive-construction probe. Build a benchmark only after adding non-closeout controls or contrastive negatives.

paper_claim: FDA provides public warning and closeout letters with regulatory resolution language. The domain is a useful stress test because a good construction agent should not force an SEC-style schema. Linked warning-closeout pairs can support outcome tracing or contrastive resolution verification.
